messages:
Zoe: quick flag  noticed conversion dip in post-launch dashboard for demo requests (last 24h). link: https://dash.redwood/launch/funnel
Miguel: saw the same. leads stable, demos down ~35% in NA. any recent page or form changes?
Priya: we rolled a tiny copy tweak and an experiment on the CTA color yesterday at 04:00 PT. but that shouldn't impact demo flow after signup.
Zoe: can we segment by acquisition channel and landing variant?
Priya: running quick query:

```
SELECT channel, landing_variant, count(*) leads, sum(is_demo::int) demos
FROM events.signups
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-22' AND ts < '2026-03-23'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY leads DESC;
```

Priya: results: organic + v1 -> 1,210 leads, demos 48 (3.9%); paid + v2 -> 980 leads, demos 2 (0.2%) — huge disparity on paid/v2.
Miguel: paid/v2 stands out. did ad creative change or landing redirect alter querystring params?
Priya: checking logs  discovery: paid landing v2 strips referral param "ref" before redirect, which we use to signal demo-prefilled flow.
Zoe: so demo-prefill lost -> users see fewer demo prompts -> lower demo conversions. can we restore param mapping or add a fallback in ingestion?
Miguel: short term: add server-side mapping that treats missing ref as "paid_unknown" and trigger demo prompt for that cohort. medium: fix redirect to preserve ref.
Priya: I'll open a small backfill job to recalc demo flags for affected signups in last 24h and patch the dashboard.
kpi-bot: KPI note: demo requests last 24h = 62 (expected ~95). Ingestion anomaly: none. Action tickets: MK-5100 (backfill), MK-5101 (redirect fix).
Zoe: thanks. Miguel please own redirect with eng. Priya run backfill and update dashboard. Reconvene in the morning KPI review with before/after numbers.
Miguel: on it, pinging eng-frontend. starting redirect patch thread.
Priya: backfill queued (job id: BF-7781). will post results when done.
kpi-bot: Action summary added to weekly KPI review: "paid landing param retention + backfill for demo flags".
